svg.title: clusterer_controller overview
svg.text: clusterer_controller: how a controller-managed cluster runs
wire version 4: heartbeats from every member, no routing through other nodes, module broadcasts by multicast
The controller worker, one process per cluster: membership,
admission, election, keys, heartbeats. Every packet sealed
(XChaCha20-Poly1305), replay windows, a per-source rate limit.
Any process sends; 2 reader processes (mcast_workers) receive.

The master, every second: MASTER_ALIVE (session key)

Every 5 s also MASTER_BEACON (bootstrap key): a
master of another partition hears it, and the lower-
ranked one merges (rank: members heard, term, a
raised term over one kept, IP).
Capability states ride the heartbeat (no CAP_UPDATE
over BIN). A node syncs over TCP from one whose
state is OK; the chunks wait for the broadcasts sent
Master: the highest IP among members
past its learned wait: 3 to 15 s, from
No election between KEY_GRANT and MEMBER_LIST. None for 4 s after going ACTIVE
while following a master. While no master is heard (an election in progress)
members tell joiners to wait, so a joiner never founds a cluster of its own.
GOODBYE: the others re-elect at once; KEY_HANDOFF gives master_salt to the next
master, so the session key survives.
Two masters after a partition heals: each hears the other's MASTER_BEACON, and the
one with fewer members heard (then the lower term, then the one that kept its term
unconfirmed, then the lower IP) merges into the other (E_CL_CTR_MERGE).
MAINT_SET carries maintenance; RESYNC: a member whose view differs asks the master
